subject.title: feat(android): add Wear real-time Talk controls

question: Should this bundled Wear realtime Talk capability ship with the new phone/watch/Gateway protocol contracts in the next Android release?
rationale: Code review can assess the implementation, but it cannot choose the permanent mixed-version support and coordinated-release obligations created by a bundled cross-device feature.

options.title: Ship after compatibility proof
options.body: Land the feature after safe version-skew behavior is documented or tested and all exact-head gates pass.

options.title: Coordinate matched versions
options.body: Accept an explicit release policy requiring compatible phone, watch, and Gateway versions for realtime Talk.

options.title: Defer continuous Talk
options.body: Retain the existing one-shot Wear voice controls until maintainers want to own the larger realtime protocol lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Ship after compatibility proof
recommendation.body: Land the feature after safe version-skew behavior is documented or tested and all exact-head gates pass.
